summary_en: Mebuki Financial Group authorized acquisition of up to 9.0 million shares (0.95% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥10.0 billion through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 12 to December 21, 2026, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Mebuki Financial Group's board of directors resolved to acquire treasury stock under the authorization granted by the company's articles of incorporation pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act. The acquisition program authorizes purchases of up to 9.0 million ordinary shares, representing 0.95% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock held as of September 30, 2026 (938,795,306 shares), for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥10.0 billion.

The shares will be acquired through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 12 to December 21, 2026. No ceiling price per share was disclosed. The company stated that the acquisition is intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. The company held 8,259,912 treasury shares as of the reference date of September 30, 2026.
